headline: Dallas Baptist ends Western Washington's winning run
dek: Western Washington beat Concordia Irvine to stay unbeaten in November before falling at home to Dallas Baptist. The conference leader closes with eighteen wins, three draws and three losses, having scored 33 goals and conceded eight.
displaced_by: Dallas Baptist beat Western Washington, ending its shutout run and lifting its goals conceded to eight.
